required.quote: A certificate of registration as a home inspector may not be renewed unless the home inspector has complied with the continuing competency requirements established by the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Required insurance ceases to be in effect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the insurance required in AS 08.18.101 ceases to be in effect, the registration of the contractor or home inspector shall be suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final judgment impairs surety bond or depletes cash deposit below required amount
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a final judgment impairs the liability of the surety upon the bond or depletes the cash deposit so that there is not in effect a bond undertaking or cash deposit in the full amount prescribed in AS 08.18.071, the registration of the contractor or home inspector involved shall be suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Bonding company cancels the contractor's or home inspector's bond
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a bonding company cancels its bond of a contractor or home inspector, the contractor's or home inspector's registration shall be revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registered contractor or home inspector fails to fulfill obligations under bonding requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a registered contractor or registered home inspector fails to fulfill the contractor's or home inspector's obligations as set out in AS 08.18.071, the contractor's or home inspector's registration shall be suspended

bonding_required.quote: each applicant shall, at the time of applying for a certificate of registration, file with the commissioner a surety bond running to the state

insurance_required.quote: Each applicant, at the time of applying for registration or upon renewal of registration, shall file with the commissioner satisfactory evidence that the applicant has in effect ... public liability and property damage insurance covering the applicant's contracting operations in this state

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: Contractual provisions that purport to limit the liability of a home inspector to the cost of the home inspection report are contrary to public policy and void.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: A person acting in the capacity of a contractor or home inspector may not bring an action in a court of this state for the collection of compensation for the performance of work or for breach of a contract for which registration is required under this chapter without alleging and proving that the contractor or home inspector was a registered contractor or registered home inspector

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
